title: Artha
tagline: Functional metaverses w/importable data deployed on the blockchain
description: The project uses 3D technology to scan spaces and live events and present them in VR form using game engines and metaverse technology. We aim to create spaces that our users will be able to view and change depending on their needs. The assets present on our platform will be interactable, meaning the users will have the opportunity to change the present NFTs and create new ones based on their designs.
how_its_made:
3-D laser scanning (Venues) - Unity and blender software 
3D laser scanner - Faro laser scanner, scans on Opeansea
Game design - interchangeable NFTs on a semi-centralised platform 
Software engineering remote controllers to robotics - the ability to input other technology; software and physics into files 
Smart contract protocols
